prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic close-up studio portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with a playful street-chic attitude against a matte black background.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with shoulder-length voluminous blonde curls, fair skin with natural texture, minimal makeup, and a cheeky smile. She winks at camera, tilts her head slightly, and playfully brings her thumb near her mouth. She wears a distressed brown leather jacket over a black ribbed crew-neck top and a silver statement necklace.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level shoulders-and-head portrait against a seamless matte-black studio background, with face and eye catchlight as focal point and leather texture visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal beauty-dish or ring-light illumination, gentle hair shadows, even face light, high contrast against black, playful confident energetic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic 85mm portrait photography, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, sharp face, 4:5 vertical framing, detailed pores, curls, leather, and jewelry.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 close-up studio portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with shoulder-length voluminous natural curls, fair realistic skin, minimal makeup, and a cheeky smile. She winks at the camera, tilts her head slightly, and playfully brings her thumb near her mouth. Dress her in a distressed brown vintage leather jacket over a black ribbed crew-neck top with a silver statement necklace. Use a seamless matte-black background, soft frontal beauty-dish light, a bright eye catchlight, gentle hair shadows, 85mm f/1.8 perspective, sharp facial detail, and edgy playful street-chic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, malformed teeth
